description: Built an asset management module for Odoo so the company can record and track its assets in the system it already uses. Optimised slow database queries, fixed broken report exports and form-logic failures in the HRIS to restore accurate, dependable HR reporting, and automated LMS video compression with a Bash and FFmpeg pipeline that standardises formats and reduces storage overhead.

Launched a client-facing e-commerce site for Mawar Florist where customers order and pay online, with Xendit checkout, webhook-based transaction status, and one place for the owner to monitor transactions, product sales, and financial reports. Also delivered a company profile and blog platform for Odo Dental Indonesia, giving the clinic an online presence and a blog that attracts new patients through search. Worked directly with clients to scope requirements, triage issues, and prioritise fixes after launch.

flow: Android app ⇄ CMS ⇄ backend → real-time sync
description: Built the CMS and APIs for a hospitality IPTV product, letting hotel staff and administrators update content, schedules, and user settings in real time, with changes synced instantly to the IPTV app on Android TVs and set-top boxes. Also built an automated block and unblock feature for an OLT provisioning and billing system that suspends a customer's service when an invoice stays unpaid beyond the grace period and restores it once payment is received.

Delivered an AI service that condenses learning modules into short summaries, helping learners understand material faster. Built the FastAPI backend with REST endpoints for on-demand and batch generation, and a Qdrant retrieval pipeline (chunked vector storage and semantic search) that feeds relevant context to DeepSeek, keeping summaries grounded in the source content.
